findings.title: Global view permission is treated as permission to manage groups
findings.body: `canManage()` accepts either `VIEW` or `MANAGE` on the all-groups resource. As a result, an administrator granted only global group viewing can pass `requireManage()` and perform operations such as creating or deleting groups. Only the `MANAGE` scope should authorize management.

findings.title: Group filtering uses authorization resource IDs instead of group IDs
findings.body: `getGroupIdsWithViewPermission()` returns `groupResource.getId()`, which is the authorization resource's ID, but callers pass this set to user search/count APIs that filter by actual group IDs. Administrators with group-member view permissions therefore get incorrect results (typically no matching users). Add the group ID represented by the resource name instead.
